analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price (1,262,000 KRW) vs SMA5 (1,482,000 KRW)/SMA20 (1,710,350 KRW)/SMA50 (1,671,148 KRW): Below short-term and mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100 (1,919,760 KRW)/SMA200 (1,452,545 KRW): Below long-term trends, maintaining weak strength.
· 52-week position (32.8%) + Current price level is high relative to the 52-week low (420,500 KRW).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (46.6→25.1): Entered oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-6856.1846→-57833.1178): Weakness persists, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band 1,392,079 KRW): Approaching the lower band, with a high volatility of 37.22% band width.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (1,246,000 KRW): Close to the 5-day low (1,250,000 KRW).
· Swing Resistance (1,890,000 KRW): High level relative to current price; potential for mid-term trend reversal if broken.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (1,759,000 KRW/1,250,000 KRW, 1,935,000 KRW/1,250,000 KRW): No Lower Low pattern formed, range-bound phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.77x): Recent movement is supported by volume, increasing confidence.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Premature to enter a buy due to RSI entering oversold and ADX remaining non-trending.
